FlowerPainter.Feature.bigStatue.Tooltip: A statue scaled up to monumental size on a stepped plinth at the head of an axis, with an avenue of lamps, flags or trees leading to it.
FlowerPainter.Feature.folly.Tooltip: A Palace of Fine Arts style folly made of props: a rotunda of columns round a statue, a lagoon in front and colonnade walks you can stroll through.
FlowerPainter.Feature.obelisk.Tooltip: A tall obelisk on a stepped base in a paved court with corner pieces, benches and a low hedge ring.
FlowerPainter.Feature.triumphalArch.Tool: A gateway astride a wide walk: a triumphal arch, a pair of pylons or a screen of columns, with statues and flags.
FlowerPainter.Feature.sculptureWalk.Tool: A walk lined with sculptures on paved pads, each framed by shrubs with a bench facing it.
FlowerPainter.Feature.terraceGarden.Tool: A circle or oval of terraces with radial spokes and ring walks round a statue or fountain, with a small amphitheatre carved into one side.
FlowerPainter.Monuments.Issue.Smaller: The {0} was made smaller to fit the free space.
FlowerPainter.Monuments.Issue.ScaledDown: The {0} was scaled down to fit its space.
FlowerPainter.Monuments.Issue.NoColumns: No columns are installed: trees (or statues) stand in for them.
FlowerPainter.Monuments.Issue.NoArch: No arch is installed: a pair of pylons frames the walk instead.
FlowerPainter.Monuments.Issue.NoObelisk: No obelisk is installed: a monument or statue stands on the base instead.
FlowerPainter.Monuments.Issue.WaterNotFl: The ground is not flat enough for real water: the pool uses a water-look surface.
FlowerPainter.Monuments.Issue.FewerSculp: Only {0} of {1} sculptures fit along the walk.
FlowerPainter.Monuments.Issue.NoRoomForC: There was no room for the centrepiece in the rotunda.
FlowerPainter.Monuments.Issue.AmphiNeeds: The amphitheatre needs sunken terraces (seats look down to the stage), so it was left out.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.BigStatue.Name: Big statue
FlowerPainter.AddOn.BigStatue.kind.Toolt: A single figure, a group (the main figure with two lesser ones) or a colossus (larger still, on a taller base).
FlowerPainter.AddOn.BigStatue.size.Toolt: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the statue is built. It is scaled down when the space is too small.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.BigStatue.plinth.Too: Raises the ground under the statue in square steps (permanent terrain change).
FlowerPainter.AddOn.BigStatue.focal.Tool: At the far end of the axis, or in the middle with the approach on one side.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.BigStatue.avenue.Too: What lines the approach, in matching pairs.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Obelisk.Name: Obelisk
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Obelisk.size.Tooltip: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the obelisk is built.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Obelisk.steps.Toolti: Square steps raised in the ground under the obelisk (permanent terrain change). 0 = none.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Obelisk.corners.Tool: Four matching pieces on the court's diagonals.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Obelisk.hedgeRing.To: A low hedge round the court with an opening on each axis.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.TriumphalArch.Name: Triumphal gateway
FlowerPainter.AddOn.TriumphalArch.kind.T: A triumphal arch astride the walk, a pair of pylons framing it, or a propylaea: a screen of columns with the walk through the middle.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.TriumphalArch.size.T: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the arch, pylons or columns are built.
Four statues on the corners of the square, facing along the walk.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.TriumphalArch.square: Paving under and round the gateway.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.SculptureWalk.Name: Sculpture walk
A gentle S-curve, a straight gallery or a zigzag.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.SculptureWalk.size.T: How much bigger than the assets' normal size the sculptures are built.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.SculptureWalk.variet: Each sculpture a little bigger or smaller, so the walk has rhythm.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.SculptureWalk.backdr: An arc of clipped shrubs behind each sculpture.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Folly.Name: Folly (rotunda)
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Folly.columns.Toolti: Columns in the rotunda's ring. Where the walk passes, the ring opens (with an arch when one is installed).
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Folly.columnScale.To: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the columns (and arches) are built.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Folly.arches.Tooltip: Arches where the walk enters and leaves the rotunda (only when arch assets are installed).
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Folly.arms.Tooltip: Columns on both sides of the walk curving round the lagoon from the rotunda: a colonnade you walk through.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Folly.armSpan.Toolti: How far round the lagoon each colonnade arm reaches from the rotunda.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Folly.lagoon.Tooltip: An oval pool in front of the rotunda, so it is seen across the water.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Folly.realWater.Tool: Digs the lagoon and fills it with water (permanent, flat ground only). Otherwise a water-look surface.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.Folly.planting.Toolt: Shrubs at the ends of the lagoon and a backdrop of trees behind the rotunda.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.TerraceGarden.Name: Terrace garden
FlowerPainter.AddOn.TerraceGarden.direct: Stepping down to the centre (sunken), up to it (a garden mount) or flat. Terraces reshape the ground permanently.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.TerraceGarden.spokes: Radial walks from the inner ring to the outer ring; one points at the entrance and runs on to it.
Oval walks on the innermost and outermost terraces, joined to every spoke.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.TerraceGarden.size.T: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the central statue is built (fountains up to 200 %).
FlowerPainter.AddOn.TerraceGarden.amphit: Carves the side opposite the entrance into rows of seats looking down at a small stage in front of the centrepiece (sunken terraces only).
